title.en: NVIDIA becomes the world's most valuable company, a symbolic peak of AI-driven market dominance
title.zhHans: NVIDIA 成为全球市值最高公司，AI 驱动市场主导地位的标志性时刻

searchSummary.en: NVIDIA became the world’s most valuable company in June 2024 — a symbolic milestone of AI-driven market dominance. Timeline of NVIDIA’s rise to the top.
searchSummary.zhHans: NVIDIA 于 2024 年 6 月成为全球市值最高公司——AI 驱动市场主导地位的标志性时刻。NVIDIA 登顶之路的时间线。

summary.en: On June 18, 2024, NVIDIA's market capitalization reached $3.34 trillion, surpassing Microsoft to become the world's most valuable publicly listed company. The milestone crystallized a historic shift: a chip company whose value was built on AI hardware had overtaken the software giant that defined the PC era. NVIDIA's ascent was powered by surging demand for its GPUs, which had become the essential infrastructure for training and running large AI models. The moment was widely interpreted as AI moving from 'emerging technology' to 'the dominant force in global capital markets.'
summary.zhHans: 2024 年 6 月 18 日，NVIDIA 市值达到 3.34 万亿美元，超越微软成为全球市值最高的上市公司。这一里程碑凝固了一个历史性转变：一家价值建立在 AI 硬件之上的芯片公司，超越了定义 PC 时代的软件巨头。NVIDIA 的崛起得益于对其 GPU 的激增需求——GPU 已成为训练和运行大型 AI 模型不可或缺的基础设施。这一时刻被广泛解读为 AI 从"新兴技术"转变为"全球资本市场的支配力量"。

narrative.en: NVIDIA's journey to the top of global market capitalization was unprecedented in speed and scale. The company had been known primarily as a gaming GPU maker until the AI boom, when its CUDA ecosystem made its chips the default choice for AI training and inference. By 2024, NVIDIA's data center revenue had surged, driven by demand for H100 and B100 GPUs from every major AI company — OpenAI, Google, Meta, Microsoft, Anthropic, and countless startups. The June 18, 2024 milestone was not just about a stock price — it was a symbolic moment that crystallized AI's transition from an emerging technology to the central organizing force of global capital markets. NVIDIA briefly held the title (later swapping positions with Microsoft and Apple before reaching $4 trillion in July 2025), but the symbolism was historic: the most valuable company in the world was now one whose primary business was building the infrastructure for AI. This was a far cry from the 'dot-com' era, where infrastructure companies (Cisco, Sun) were merely enablers — now the enabler itself was worth more than the software companies it served.
narrative.zhHans: NVIDIA 登上全球市值榜首的历程在速度和规模上都是前所未有的。在 AI 热潮之前，该公司主要被视为游戏 GPU 制造商；其 CUDA 生态系统使其芯片成为 AI 训练和推理的默认选择。到 2024 年，NVIDIA 的数据中心收入激增，由 OpenAI、Google、Meta、Microsoft、Anthropic 以及无数初创公司对 H100 和 B100 GPU 的需求驱动。2024 年 6 月 18 日的里程碑不仅仅是股价——它是一个象征性时刻，凝固了 AI 从新兴技术向全球资本市场中心力量的转变。NVIDIA 短暂持有这一头衔（后来与微软和苹果交替领先，直到 2025 年 7 月达到 4 万亿美元），但象征意义是历史性的：全球最有价值的公司现在是一家主要业务是构建 AI 基础设施的公司。这与"互联网泡沫"时代形成鲜明对比——当时基础设施公司（Cisco、Sun）只是赋能者——而现在赋能者本身的价值超过了它所服务的软件公司。

description.en: Symbolic peak of AI-driven market transformation. A hardware/infrastructure company overtaking traditional software giants. Accelerated capital allocation toward AI infrastructure spending.
description.zhHans: AI 驱动的市场转型的象征性高峰。一家硬件/基础设施公司超越传统软件巨头。加速了资本向 AI 基础设施支出配置。

description.en: Shifted public perception: AI was no longer a speculative technology but the dominant force in global capital markets.
description.zhHans: 转变了公众认知：AI 不再是一种投机性技术，而是全球资本市场的支配力量。

text.en: NVIDIA's market cap reached $3.34 trillion on June 18, 2024, surpassing Microsoft to become the world's most valuable publicly traded company.
text.zhHans: NVIDIA 市值于 2024 年 6 月 18 日达到 3.34 万亿美元，超越微软成为全球市值最高的上市公司。
